item.title: Nyiwa Drops Debut Single ‘Veza’ Ahead of Upcoming Album ‘Of the Soul' - SlikourOnLife
item.description: Nyiwa officially introduces his artistry with the release of his debut single “Veza,” which dropped today. Serving as his first official release, the track marks a defining moment in his career and sets the foundation for his musical identity. “Veza” is the lead single from his upcoming debut album, Of the Soul, offering an early glimpse into the sound and direction that will shape the full project.

item.title: “I’m Thoroughly Impressed,“ Reason on Nasty C’s Pen on Four Horsemen - SlikourOnLife
item.description: Reason spoke about being impressed by Nasty C’s pen on Four Horsemen during a discussion on Podcast and Chill with MacG*. He referenced the way the hook connected to the verse, how the lines were arranged, and how the lyrics were layered. Reason stated that although the song featured several strong writers, Nasty C’s execution stood out to him, leading him to describe it as one that thoroughly impressed him and acknowledged his overall lyrical approach.
